about: A Python framework for web scraping, from a single request to a full crawl.

prs.title: XPath questions that return a single value now work
prs.broken: Scrapling pulls data from web pages with XPath. Asking for one value, like the text of a heading or a count of items, crashed instead of answering.
prs.changed: The value now comes back the normal way, including an empty text or a zero.
prs.matters: Scripts can read text and count items in one query, with the same answers as the parsel library.

prs.title: Pasted curl commands with the redirect flag now convert
prs.broken: Scrapling can turn a curl command into its own request. Commands with the common flag for following redirects were refused with an error.
prs.changed: The flag is now accepted. Requests already follow redirects, so nothing else changes.
prs.matters: Curl commands copied from docs or a browser work without editing.
